---

Please do not paste a real `otpauth://` URI, a QR code, a backup file or a
sync token. They contain the secret itself. If a specific account's data is
the problem, describe its shape — issuer, digits, period, algorithm — or make
a throwaway account that shows the same thing.

If this is a security vulnerability, do not file it here. See SECURITY.md.
